f3_program: collection("cara.bag.marbles", "marble", "bag", source("Cara has 60 marbles in a bag"))
observe(at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"), 60, "count", source("Cara has 60 marbles in a bag"))
observe(at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("20 of them are yellow"))
fraction_of(at("cara.bag.marbles.green.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("half as many are green"))
same(at("cara.bag.marbles.red.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), source("equally divided between red and blue"))

sum_relation(at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.yellow.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.green.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.red.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), source("20 of them are yellow, half as many are green, and the remaining marbles are equally divided between red and blue"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("cara.bag.marbles.blue.count", "current"), at("cara.bag.marbles.count", "current"))
collection("jenny.dropped_popcorn_kernels", "popcorn_kernel", "school_home_route.ground", source("the popcorn Jenny had dropped on her way home"))
observe(at("jenny.home_school.distance", "current"), 5000, "foot", source("Jenny lives 5000 feet from her school"))
same(at("jenny.walked_distance", "walk_home_day"), at("jenny.home_school.distance", "current"), source("she was walking home from school"))
observe(at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate_kernel_count", "walk_home_day"), 1, "count", source("1 kernel of popcorn"))
observe(at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate_distance", "walk_home_day"), 25, "foot", source("25 feet"))

quotient_relation(at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate", "walk_home_day"), at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate_kernel_count", "walk_home_day"), at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate_distance", "walk_home_day"), source("1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

rate_relation(at("jenny.popcorn_drop.total_kernel_count", "walk_home_day"), at("jenny.popcorn_drop.rate", "walk_home_day"), at("jenny.walked_distance", "walk_home_day"), source("she dropped 1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

add("drop_popcorn", "jenny", at("jenny.dropped_popcorn_kernels.count", "current"), at("jenny.popcorn_drop.total_kernel_count", "walk_home_day"), source("she dropped 1 kernel of popcorn per 25 feet she walked"))

consume("squirrel_eats_popcorn", "squirrel", at("jenny.dropped_popcorn_kernels.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("drop_popcorn", "quantity"), 1, 4), source("a squirrel came and ate one-quarter of the popcorn Jenny had dropped on her way home"))
query("remaining_count", "jenny.dropped_popcorn_kernels", "following_morning")
observe(at("brendan.earnings.amount", "june"), 5000, "currency", source("In June, he earned $5000"))
add("june_earnings", "brendan", at("brendan.money.available.amount", "current"), at("brendan.earnings.amount", "june"), source("In June, he earned $5000"))

transfer("debit_card_recharge", "brendan", at("brendan.money.available.amount", "current"), at("brendan.debit_card.balance", "current"), fraction(event_field("june_earnings", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("he recharges his debit card with half of his pay"))
observe(at("brendan.used_car.value", "purchase"), 1500, "currency", source("a used car worth $1500"))
remove("buy_used_car", "brendan", at("brendan.money.available.amount", "current"), at("brendan.used_car.value", "purchase"), source("bought himself a used car worth $1500"))
query("value", at("brendan.money.available.amount", "current"))
observe(at("jan.barrel.water.volume", "initial"), 65, "gallon", source("Jan collected 65 gallons of water in a barrel outside her home"))
observe(at("jan.car_cleaning.car_count", "current"), 2, "count", source("the two cars"))
observe(at("jan.car_cleaning.water_per_car", "current"), 7, "gallon", source("7 gallons of water each"))

product_relation(at("jan.car_cleaning.water.total", "current"), at("jan.car_cleaning.water_per_car", "current"), at("jan.car_cleaning.car_count", "current"), source("7 gallons of water each to clean the two cars"))
consume("clean_two_cars", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.volume", "current"), at("jan.car_cleaning.water.total", "current"), source("uses 7 gallons of water each to clean the two cars"))
offset(at("jan.plant_watering.water.amount", "current"), at("jan.car_cleaning.water.total", "current"), -11, "gallon", source("uses 11 fewer gallons than the two cars to water the plants"))
consume("water_plants", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.volume", "current"), at("jan.plant_watering.water.amount", "current"), source("uses 11 fewer gallons than the two cars to water the plants"))

consume("wash_plates_and_clothes", "jan", at("jan.barrel.water.volume", "current"), fraction(at("jan.barrel.water.volume", "current"), 1, 2), source("uses half of the remaining gallons of water to wash the plates and clothes"))
query("value", event_field("wash_plates_and_clothes", "quantity"))
